sc_runtime.code:
import time, threading
_cache, _locks = {}, {}
MARGIN = 60  # seconds before expiry to refresh

def get_access_token(db, kms, app, tenant, conn_id, audience):
    key = (tenant, conn_id)
    tok = _cache.get(key)
    if tok and tok['audience'] == audience and tok['expires_at'] - MARGIN > time.time():
        return tok
    lock = _locks.setdefault(key, threading.Lock())
    with lock:  # tricky part: one refresh at a time, single-use refresh tokens
        tok = _cache.get(key)
        if tok and tok['expires_at'] - MARGIN > time.time():
            return tok
        rec = db.load(tenant, conn_id)
        refresh = kms.decrypt(rec.key_ref, rec.enc_refresh_token)
        try:
            new = app.refresh(refresh)  # {access_token, refresh_token, expires_in}
        except app.Rejected:
            db.set_status(tenant, conn_id, 'needs_reauth')
            raise NeedsReauth(conn_id)
        db.save(tenant, conn_id, kms.encrypt(rec.key_ref, new['refresh_token']))
        refresh = None  # drop plaintext
        tok = {'access_token': new['access_token'], 'audience': audience,
               'expires_at': time.time() + new['expires_in']}
        _cache[key] = tok
        db.audit(tenant, conn_id, rec.key_ref)  # key_ref only, never the token
        return tok
